result_text:
Staff logins are now limited to Calendar and Clients, and the owner-only checks run on the server. `pnpm test` passes, lint is clean, and `pnpm build` succeeds. I did not run the app or the integration tests, since Postgres and Redis aren't available here.

- **Server-side guard:** `requireOwner()` in `src/lib/session.ts` redirects non-owners to `/admin`. The five owner-only server actions in `src/app/admin/actions.ts` (save/toggle service, save/toggle staff, toggle staff-service) now call it. A replayed form submission from a staff session is refused before any database write.
- **Owner-only pages:** Services, Staff, Reports, Analytics, Notifications and Audit call `requireOwner()`, so a staff member who opens one of these URLs is sent to the calendar.
- **Staff-allowed:** Calendar (including the completed/no-show/cancelled buttons, via `updateBookingStatus`) and Clients still use `requireSession()`.
- **Nav:** `src/app/admin/layout.tsx` hides the six owner-only links from staff. Owners see the same nav as before.

One thing I left alone: a session stores the role from login and lasts up to 7 days. If an owner later changes someone's role in the database, that person keeps their old access until the session expires. Fixing that would mean re-reading the role on each request, which is outside this issue.

The changes are uncommitted in the working tree.
